verses.original: Συμεὼν Πέτρος δοῦλος καὶ ἀπόστολος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ Τοῖς ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ ἡμῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ λαχοῦσιν πίστιν ἰσότιμον ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: Symeōn Petros doulos kai apostolos Iēsou Christou Tois en dikaiosynē hēmōn tou Theou kai Sōtēros Iēsou Christou lachousin pistin isotimon hēmin
verses.literal: Simon Peter a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ To those who through [the] righteousness of our - God and Savior Jesus Christ have received a faith as precious as ours

verses.original: Χάρις καὶ εἰρήνη πληθυνθείη ὑμῖν ἐν ἐπιγνώσει τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Ἰησοῦ ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: Charis kai eirēnē plēthyntheiē hymin en epignōsei tou Theou kai Iēsou hēmōn tou Kyriou
verses.literal: Grace and peace be multiplied to you through [the] knowledge - of God and of Jesus our - Lord

verses.original: Ὡς τὰ αὐτοῦ θείας τῆς δυνάμεως δεδωρημένης ἡμῖν πάντα τὰ πρὸς ζωὴν καὶ εὐσέβειαν διὰ τῆς ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ καλέσαντος ἡμᾶς ἰδίᾳ δόξῃ καὶ ἀρετῇ
verses.transliteration: Hōs ta autou theias tēs dynameōs dedōrēmenēs hēmin panta ta pros zōēn kai eusebeian dia tēs epignōseōs tou kalesantos hēmas idia doxē kai aretē
verses.literal: - - His divine - power has given us everything [we need] for life and godliness through the knowledge of Him who called us [by His] own glory and excellence

verses.original: δι’ ὧν δεδώρηται ἡμῖν τὰ τίμια καὶ μέγιστα ἐπαγγέλματα ἵνα διὰ τούτων γένησθε κοινωνοὶ θείας φύσεως ἀποφυγόντες τῆς φθορᾶς ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἐν ἐπιθυμίᾳ
verses.transliteration: di’ hōn dedōrētai hēmin ta timia kai megista epangelmata hina dia toutōn genēsthe koinōnoi theias physeōs apophygontes tēs phthoras en tō kosmō en epithymia
verses.literal: Through [these] He has given us [His] precious and magnificent promises so that through [them] you may become partakers of [the] divine nature now that you have escaped the corruption in the world caused by evil desires

verses.original: δὲ Καὶ τοῦτο αὐτὸ παρεισενέγκαντες πᾶσαν σπουδὴν ἐπιχορηγήσατε ἐν ὑμῶν τῇ πίστει τὴν ἀρετήν δὲ ἐν τῇ ἀρετῇ τὴν γνῶσιν
verses.transliteration: de Kai touto auto pareisenenkantes pasan spoudēn epichorēgēsate en hymōn tē pistei tēn aretēn de en tē aretē tēn gnōsin
verses.literal: vvv vvv For this very [reason] make every effort to add to your - faith - virtue and to - virtue - knowledge

verses.original: δὲ ἐν τῇ γνώσει τὴν ἐγκράτειαν δὲ ἐν τῇ ἐγκρατείᾳ τὴν ὑπομονήν δὲ ἐν τῇ ὑπομονῇ τὴν εὐσέβειαν
verses.transliteration: de en tē gnōsei tēn enkrateian de en tē enkrateia tēn hypomonēn de en tē hypomonē tēn eusebeian
verses.literal: and to - knowledge - self-control and to - self-control - perseverance and to - perseverance - godliness

verses.original: δὲ ἐν τῇ εὐσεβείᾳ τὴν φιλαδελφίαν δὲ ἐν τῇ φιλαδελφίᾳ τὴν ἀγάπην
verses.transliteration: de en tē eusebeia tēn philadelphian de en tē philadelphia tēn agapēn
verses.literal: and to - godliness - brotherly kindness and to - brotherly kindness - love

verses.original: γὰρ ὑμῖν ὑπάρχοντα ταῦτα καὶ πλεονάζοντα οὐκ καθίστησιν ἀργοὺς οὐδὲ ἀκάρπους εἰς τὴν ἐπίγνωσιν ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar hymin hyparchonta tauta kai pleonazonta ouk kathistēsin argous oude akarpous eis tēn epignōsin hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: For [if] you possess these [ qualities ] and continue to grow [in them] vvv they will keep you from being ineffective and unproductive in [your] knowledge of our - Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: γὰρ ᾧ μὴ πάρεστιν ταῦτα ἐστιν μυωπάζων τυφλός λαβὼν λήθην τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ αὐτοῦ πάλαι τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: gar hō mē parestin tauta estin myōpazōn typhlos labōn lēthēn tou katharismou autou palai tōn hamartiōn
verses.literal: [But] whoever vvv lacks these [ traits ] is nearsighted to the point of blindness vvv having forgotten that he has been cleansed from his past - sins

verses.original: Διὸ ἀδελφοί σπουδάσατε μᾶλλον ποιεῖσθαι ὑμῶν τὴν κλῆσιν καὶ ἐκλογὴν βεβαίαν γὰρ ποιοῦντες ταῦτα οὐ μὴ ποτε πταίσητέ
verses.transliteration: Dio adelphoi spoudasate mallon poieisthai hymōn tēn klēsin kai eklogēn bebaian gar poiountes tauta ou mē pote ptaisēte
verses.literal: Therefore brothers strive . . . to make your - calling and election sure For if you practice these things {you will} never . . . . . . stumble

verses.original: γὰρ οὕτως ὑμῖν ἐπιχορηγηθήσεται πλουσίως ἡ εἴσοδος εἰς τὴν αἰώνιον βασιλείαν ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου καὶ Σωτῆρος Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar houtōs hymin epichorēgēthēsetai plousiōs hē eisodos eis tēn aiōnion basileian hēmōn tou Kyriou kai Sōtēros Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: and . . . you will receive a lavish - reception into the eternal kingdom of our - Lord and Savior Jesus Christ

verses.original: Διὸ μελλήσω ἀεὶ ὑπομιμνῄσκειν ὑμᾶς περὶ τούτων καίπερ εἰδότας καὶ ἐστηριγμένους ἐν τῇ ἀληθείᾳ παρούσῃ
verses.transliteration: Dio mellēsō aei hypomimnēskein hymas peri toutōn kaiper eidotas kai estērigmenous en tē alētheia parousē
verses.literal: Therefore I will always remind you of these things even though you know [them] and are established in the truth you now have

verses.original: δὲ ἡγοῦμαι δίκαιον διεγείρειν ὑμᾶς ἐν ὑπομνήσει ἐφ’ ὅσον εἰμὶ ἐν τούτῳ τῷ σκηνώματι
verses.transliteration: de hēgoumai dikaion diegeirein hymas en hypomnēsei eph’ hoson eimi en toutō tō skēnōmati
verses.literal: - I think it is right to refresh your vvv memory as long as I [live] in - the tent [ of my body ]

verses.original: εἰδὼς ὅτι μου τοῦ σκηνώματός ἐστιν ταχινή ἡ ἀπόθεσις καθὼς καὶ ἡμῶν ὁ Κύριος Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς ἐδήλωσέν μοι
verses.transliteration: eidōs hoti mou tou skēnōmatos estin tachinē hē apothesis kathōs kai hēmōn ho Kyrios Iēsous Christos edēlōsen moi
verses.literal: because I know that vvv vvv this tent will soon - be laid aside as . . . our - Lord Jesus Christ has made clear to me

verses.original: δὲ καὶ σπουδάσω μετὰ ἐμὴν τὴν ἔξοδον ὑμᾶς ἔχειν ποιεῖσθαι μνήμην τὴν τούτων ἑκάστοτε
verses.transliteration: de kai spoudasō meta emēn tēn exodon hymas echein poieisthai mnēmēn tēn toutōn hekastote
verses.literal: And . . . I will make every effort to ensure [that] after my - departure you will vvv be able to recall - these things at all times

verses.original: γὰρ Οὐ ἐξακολουθήσαντες σεσοφισμένοις μύθοις ἐγνωρίσαμεν ὑμῖν τὴν δύναμιν καὶ παρουσίαν ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἀλλ’ γενηθέντες ἐπόπται ἐκείνου τῆς μεγαλειότητος
verses.transliteration: gar Ou exakolouthēsantes sesophismenois mythois egnōrisamen hymin tēn dynamin kai parousian hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou all’ genēthentes epoptai ekeinou tēs megaleiotētos
verses.literal: For vvv we did not follow cleverly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our - Lord Jesus Christ but we were eyewitnesses of His - majesty

verses.original: γὰρ λαβὼν τιμὴν καὶ δόξαν παρὰ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς φωνῆς ἐνεχθείσης αὐτῷ ὑπὸ τῆς μεγαλοπρεποῦς δόξης τοιᾶσδε οὗτός ἐστιν μου μου ὁ ἀγαπητός Ὁ Υἱός εἰς ὃν ἐγὼ εὐδόκησα
verses.transliteration: gar labōn timēn kai doxan para Theou Patros phōnēs enechtheisēs autō hypo tēs megaloprepous doxēs toiasde houtos estin mou mou ho agapētos Ho Huios eis hon egō eudokēsa
verses.literal: For He received honor and glory from God [the] Father [when] the voice came to Him from the Majestic Glory saying This is My - - beloved - Son in whom I am well pleased

verses.original: καὶ ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν ταύτην τὴν φωνὴν ἐνεχθεῖσαν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ὄντες σὺν αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ ἁγίῳ ὄρει
verses.transliteration: kai hēmeis ēkousamen tautēn tēn phōnēn enechtheisan ex ouranou ontes syn autō en tō hagiō orei
verses.literal: And we ourselves heard this - voice . . . from heaven [when] we were with Him on the holy mountain

verses.original: Καὶ ἔχομεν τὸν λόγον προφητικὸν βεβαιότερον ποιεῖτε καλῶς προσέχοντες ᾧ ὡς λύχνῳ φαίνοντι ἐν αὐχμηρῷ τόπῳ ἕως οὗ ἡμέρα διαυγάσῃ καὶ φωσφόρος ἀνατείλῃ ἐν ὑμῶν ταῖς καρδίαις
verses.transliteration: Kai echomen ton logon prophētikon bebaioteron poieite kalōs prosechontes hō hōs lychnō phainonti en auchmērō topō heōs hou hēmera diaugasē kai phōsphoros anateilē en hymōn tais kardiais
verses.literal: vvv We also have the word of the prophets as confirmed beyond doubt [And] you will do well to pay attention to it as to a lamp shining in [a] dark place until [the] day dawns and [the] morning star rises in your - hearts

verses.original: πρῶτον γινώσκοντες τοῦτο ὅτι οὐ πᾶσα προφητεία γραφῆς γίνεται ἰδίας ἐπιλύσεως
verses.transliteration: prōton ginōskontes touto hoti ou pasa prophēteia graphēs ginetai idias epilyseōs
verses.literal: Above all you must understand - that no . . . prophecy of Scripture comes from [one’s] own interpretation

verses.original: γὰρ οὐ προφητεία ποτέ ἠνέχθη θελήματι ἀνθρώπου ἀλλὰ ἄνθρωποι ἐλάλησαν ἀπὸ Θεοῦ φερόμενοι ὑπὸ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος
verses.transliteration: gar ou prophēteia pote ēnechthē thelēmati anthrōpou alla anthrōpoi elalēsan apo Theou pheromenoi hypo Hagiou Pneumatos
verses.literal: For no [such] prophecy {was} ever brought forth by [the] will of man but men spoke from God as they were carried along by [the] Holy Spirit
